title: CI runs the Cucumber conformance suite for features/data
description:
`features/data/*.feature` (57 scenarios) plus `features/domain/{keep,markup_merge,score_refs}.feature` have a complete runner in `web/test/conformance/` (`cucumber.mjs`, `steps.ts`, `hooks.ts`, `world.ts`), but no npm script or CI step invokes it. The `features` CI job only runs `features/data/check-steps.mjs`, which checks step text against `STEPS.md` vocabulary and never executes a scenario.

The domain write operations `keepCandidate`, `skipCandidate`, `putOffCandidate` and `mergeMarkup` in `web/src/data/domain.ts` have no importers in `web/src`; they are exercised only by `steps.ts`. Today they are either dead in the app or untested.

Done when: an npm script runs the Cucumber suite, CI runs it (against the local `apricitus serve` backend or an in-memory one), and it is green. `features/sync/*.feature` and `features/serve/serve.feature` are either executed or marked as prose in their headers.
